# Godstack

> Single-header C libraries for platform services, graphics, UI, text, and developer tools. Use only the headers your application needs.

Godstack is an MIT-licensed collection of single-header C libraries. Headers and their opening design notes are the API source of truth; this site supplies public guides and API references. Read the relevant library's limitations before adoption. Platform and graphics libraries may require native SDKs; the CPU-only getting-started example does not.

## Start here

- [Getting started](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/guides/getting-started/): compile a minimal program.
- [Libraries](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/): choose a library.
- [AI instructions](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/ai/): prompts for Codex, Claude, and Cursor.
- [Compact setup](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/llms-small.txt).
- [Complete public documentation](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/llms-full.txt).
- [Catalog](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/catalog.json): IDs, descriptions, tags, HTML and Markdown URLs.
- [Project skill](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/agent/SKILL.md).
- [AGENTS.md snippet](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/agent/AGENTS.md).
- [Source](https://github.com/godxgun/godstack).
- [License](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/license/).

## Public documentation

- [AI and agent documentation](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/ai/): Public machine-readable Godstack documentation endpoints and grounded guidance for coding agents. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/ai.md))

- [Demos](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/demos/): Particle Observatory and 3D Snake, running shared native C code in the browser. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/demos/index.md))

- [Particle Observatory](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/demos/grit/): A luminous particle field driven by Grit pools, vectors, random numbers, and software rasterization. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/demos/grit.md))

- [Snake](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/demos/snake/): A native and browser 3D Snake game built with Peak, Grit, and Rend. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/demos/snake.md))

- [Library guides](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/): Task-oriented guides for using the Godstack C libraries, with separate symbols and demos catalogs. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/index.md))

- [Cast](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/cast/): A practical guide to tokenizing and walking C source with caller-owned memory. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/cast.md))

- [Cool](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/cool/): Use Cool output helpers for escaped text, trusted markup, and a limited Markdown subset. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/cool.md))

- [Fuse](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/fuse/): Set up caller-backed canvas storage, feed input, and render Fuse commands. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/fuse.md))

- [Grit](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/grit/): Choose caller-backed allocators and use Grit utilities with explicit lifetimes. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/grit.md))

- [Peak](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/peak/): Set up Peak runtime contexts and a platform event loop with target-specific dependencies. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/peak.md))

- [Poof](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/poof/): Construct process commands and compiler configurations with Poof. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/poof.md))

- [Rend](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/rend/): Use legacy Rend with Peak on native Vulkan and browser WebGL2. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/rend.md))

- [Type](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/type/): Place a Type context, load font bytes, and lay out and rasterize glyphs into a coverage atlas. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/type.md))

- [Wire](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/wire/): Handle GET requests with Wire on Unix and understand its deliberately narrow HTTP scope. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/docs/wire.md))

- [Guides](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/guides/): Practical introductions to building projects with Godstack libraries. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/guides/index.md))

- [Getting Started](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/guides/getting-started/): Compile a minimal C99 program that embeds the Grit single-header library. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/guides/getting-started.md))

- [License](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/license/): Godstack is released under the MIT License. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/license.md))

- [Symbols](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/): Search or browse individual Godstack API declarations, separate from the task-oriented guides. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/index.md))

- [Cast symbols](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/cast/): Types, macros, and functions declared by Cast.h. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/cast.md))

- [Cool symbols](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/cool/): Types, macros, and functions declared by Cool.h. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/cool.md))

- [Fuse symbols](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/fuse/): Types, macros, and functions declared by Fuse.h. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/fuse.md))

- [Grit symbols](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/grit/): Types, macros, and functions declared by Grit.h. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/grit.md))

- [Peak symbols](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/peak/): Types, macros, and functions declared by Peak.h. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/peak.md))

- [Poof symbols](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/poof/): Types, macros, and functions declared by Poof.h. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/poof.md))

- [Rend symbols](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/rend/): Types, macros, and functions declared by Rend.h. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/rend.md))

- [Type symbols](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/type/): Types, macros, and functions declared by Type.h. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/type.md))

- [Wire symbols](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/wire/): Types, macros, and functions declared by Wire.h. ([Markdown](https://godxgun.github.io/godstack/symbols/wire.md))

## Integration boundary

These are static, public documentation resources. There is no hosted MCP server or agent execution backend. A future MCP adapter could expose catalog lookup and document retrieval from these public files; it would need its own implementation and deployment.
